name: nc/query
title: Post list
description: Post list. Without children: card with image, linked title and excerpt. With one child: the child is the card, repeated for each post. Static: updates when posts change. With relatedTo (a taxonomy slug): lists the other posts of the same type that share a term of that taxonomy with the current post, computed at request time and cached per post.
aiHints: Use it for lists of news or articles. Keep the number of cards low (1-24). For a custom card add one child (nc/container or a ref to a section): inside it, bind and nc/post-title, nc/post-image, nc/post-meta read each post. For filters use nc/collection. For related posts (for example more articles on the same topic) set relatedTo to the taxonomy slug: the list excludes the current post and is empty when it has no terms in that taxonomy; empty "" hides the text.
